Name: Old Farmer Brand Scratcher
Author: KyleFromPelicanTown
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]Description / 描述[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Scratcher adds 锦鲤刮刮乐 (Lucky Carp Scratch Cards) and 人脉刮刮乐 (Connections Scratch Cards) to Stardew Valley. Buy them at Pierre’s, scratch them in a vanilla-style UI window, then redeem into your wallet—with coin rain (and more) when you actually win. After marriage, your spouse may even buy a few for you over the weekend. Perfect for farmers who believe this is the one.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]本模组为《星露谷物语》加入锦鲤刮刮乐与人脉刮刮乐。可在皮埃尔商店购买，在原版风格窗口中刮开，再兑换入账；中奖时还有金币雨等特效。婚后伴侣还可能周末帮你代购几张。新农民暴富，就靠这一次了。[/color][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Installation instructions / 安装说明[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]First, install SMAPI, then download and unzip this mod to the Mods folder in the game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]先安装SMAPI，然后下载本Mod解压复制到游戏的 Mods 文件夹。[/color][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Main features / 主要功能[/size][/color][/heading]
Lucky Carp / 锦鲤刮刮乐
[list]
[*]here to buy: Pierre’s General Store, year-round. About 2000g each, 10 cards per week. Selling them back gets you 0g—treat them as spent.[/*]
[*]How to play: Select the card in your inventory and use the interact key (same as eating food, usually right-click). Don’t use the tool key (usually left-click)—that won’t open the card.[/*]
[*]How to scratch: In the window, hold and drag over the silver coating to reveal each square. Scratch out a carp to win; crab-pot junk means that square doesn’t pay. You can close and come back later—progress is kept until you redeem.[/*]
[*]How payout works: Only revealed winning squares count. Prize = amount on the square × fish multiplier (Carp 1× → Scorpion Carp 2× → Midnight Carp 3× → Mahi-mahi Carp 5× → Radioactive Carp 8× → Mutant Carp 10×). Max jackpot per card is 1,000,000g.[/*]
[*]Odds (normal luck day): Roughly 4 in 10 cards have at least one winning square; about 6 in 10 are complete blanks. Among winning cards, many only roughly break even or pay less than the ticket (~2000g); bigger wins are rarer, and a full 1,000,000g prize is about 1% of winning cards (rarer overall).[/*]
[*]Luck matters: Daily luck and Luck Level slightly improve your odds of hitting prizes, rare fish, and better prize pools (capped so it never gets extreme). Opening a brand-new card “locks in” that day’s luck for that card.[/*]
[*]How to cash out: Tap Redeem. The card is destroyed. If your total is >0, money goes to your wallet and you get a coin rain; if it’s 0, the card is still gone—no payout, no effect. Tip: finish scratching before redeeming, or you’ll leave money on the card.[/*]
[*]怎么买：皮埃尔杂货店全年有售，约 2000 金/张，每周限购 10 张。卖回商店是 0 金，当作娱乐消费即可。[/*]
[*]怎么开：背包选中「锦鲤刮刮乐」，按交互键（和吃东西一样，默认右键）。别用工具键（默认左键），那样打不开。[/*]
[*]怎么刮：窗口里按住拖动，刮掉银色涂层。刮出鲤鱼类才算中奖；刮出蟹笼杂物那一格不发钱。可以先关窗下次再刮，没兑换前进度会留着。[/*]
[*]怎么算奖：只结算已经刮开的中奖格。奖金 = 格内金额 × 鱼倍率（鲤鱼 1 倍 → 蝎鲤鱼 2 倍 → 午夜鲤鱼 3 倍 → 麻哈脂鲤 5 倍 → 放射性鲤鱼 8 倍 → 变种鲤鱼 10 倍）。单卡最高 1,000,000 金。[/*]
[*]概率大概怎样（普通运气日）：大约 10 张里有 4 张至少刮出一条中奖鲤鱼，约 6 张空军。有奖的卡里，不少只是贴票价或略亏（票价约 2000）；大钱更少，满奖 100 万大约只占有奖卡的 1%（相对全部购卡更稀）。[/*]
[*]运气有用：当日运气、运气等级会略微提高中奖、稀有鱼和大奖池概率（有上下限，不会离谱）。新卡第一次生成布局时，会按当天运气定好这张卡的结果。[/*]
[*]怎么兑：点「兑换」后卡就没了。累计 >0 会入账并播金币雨；0 金也会销卡，没钱没特效。建议刮完再兑，否则没刮开的中奖格等于白扔。[/*]
[/list][line]
Connections / 人脉刮刮乐
[list]
[*]Where to buy: Pierre’s, year-round. About 3000g each, 10 cards per week (separate stock from Lucky Carp). Sell-back price is 1000g.[/*]
[*]How to play: Same as Lucky Carp—select and use the interact key.[/*]
[*]How to scratch: The layout is different—one large portrait square on top (a villager on letter paper) and five gift squares below. The large coating has a heart pattern; scratch along it to reveal who it is. Gift squares show that villager’s loved or hated gifts. Revealing a gift immediately changes friendship with that NPC (+80 loved / −40 hated) and updates their portrait expression. Progress is kept until you redeem.[/*]
[*]How payout works: Redeem converts scratched gift results into gold (can be negative). Loved gifts build up a positive total; hated gifts flip the running total negative. Cap is roughly ±100,000g. The same NPC won’t appear again on new cards this week once revealed (refreshes next week).[/*]
[*]How to cash out:[/*]
[*]Total >0: card destroyed, gold added, friendship kept, coin rain + heart rain.[/*]
[*]Total =0: card destroyed, no payout / no effect.[/*]
[*]Total <0: card destroyed, gold deducted (wallet won’t go below 0), all friendship changes from this card are rolled back, trash rain.[/*]
[*]怎么买：皮埃尔全年有售，约 3000 金/张，每周限购 10 张（与锦鲤库存分开）。卖回约 1000 金。[/*]
[*]怎么开：与锦鲤相同——背包选中后按交互键。[/*]
[*]怎么刮：布局不同——上方大格刮出村民立绘（信纸背景），下方 5 格刮出该村民最爱 / 最讨厌的礼物。大格涂层有爱心纹路，沿纹路刮开即可揭晓是谁。刮开礼物格会立刻对该 NPC 加减好感（最爱 +80 / 讨厌 −40），立绘表情也会变。没兑换前进度会留着。[/*]
[*]怎么算奖：兑换时按已刮开的礼物结果换算金币（可为负）。最爱累加正数；讨厌会把当前总额翻成负数。上下限约 ±100,000 金。本周已刮出的 NPC，新卡不会再出（下周刷新）。[/*]
[*]怎么兑：[/*]
[*]累计 >0：销卡、加钱、好感保留，金币雨 + 爱心雨。[/*]
[*]累计 =0：销卡，没钱没特效。[/*]
[*]累计 <0：销卡、扣钱（钱包不低于 0），撤回本卡全部好感变动，播垃圾雨。[/*]
[/list][line]
Spouse weekend buys / 婚后伴侣代购
If you’re married (not to Krobus), on non-festival weekends your spouse may buy scratch cards for you—without walking anywhere:
[list]
[*]Saturday 7:00: plans to buy 1–5 cards (if stock and money allow); HUD tip.[/*]
[*]Sunday 7:00: charges your wallet and Pierre’s weekly stock; HUD tip.[/*]
[*]Monday 7:00: credits winnings (Connections can be negative); HUD tip.[/*]
[/list]Cards go into your inventory flow as if purchased; you still scratch and redeem yourself. You can disable this in config.
已婚（非科罗布斯）且非节日时，伴侣可能周末帮你代购——NPC 不会真的走路：
[list]
[*]周六 7:00：打算买 1–5 张（有库存且钱够）；HUD 提示。[/*]
[*]周日 7:00：扣款并占用皮埃尔当周库存；HUD 提示。[/*]
[*]周一 7:00：中奖金入账（人脉可为负）；HUD 提示。[/*]
[/list]卡仍由你自己刮开兑换。可在配置里关闭。
[line]
Config (optional GMCM) / 配置（可选 GMCM）
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed:
[list]
[*]Disable spouse scratch-card purchases.[/*]
[*]Lucky Carp win chance slider (default 40%).[/*]
[*]Connections win chance slider (default 50%).[/*]
[/list]安装 Generic Mod Config Menu 后可调：
[list]
[*]禁止伴侣买刮刮乐[/*]
[*]锦鲤中奖概率滑条（默认 40%）[/*]
[*]人脉中奖概率滑条（默认 50%）[/*]
[/list][line]
